title: Wellness Membership Maintenance Session Allotment by Tier
content:
Maintenance sessions are wellness sessions with a physical therapist assistant or therapist, credited to a Wellness Membership each billing period on the tiers that include them.

| Tier | Sessions credited each billing period | Length of one session | Most unused sessions carried into the next billing period | How far ahead a session may be booked | Orientation sessions credited at the start |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | 0 | 0 (no sessions on this tier) | 0 | 0 (no sessions on this tier) | 1 |
| Aquatic Access Membership | 0 | 0 (no sessions on this tier) | 0 | 0 (no sessions on this tier) | 1 |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | 1 | 45 minutes | 1 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Wellness Plus Membership | 2 | 45 minutes | 2 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Performance Membership | 4 | 45 minutes | 2 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| Performance Plus Membership | 4 | 60 minutes | 4 | 45 calendar days | 1 |

## Terms on the card

- **Sessions credited each billing period** is the monthly allotment of maintenance sessions.
- **Orientation sessions** are credited once, at the start of the membership, in addition to the monthly allotment; every tier carries 1, including the two access tiers whose monthly allotment is 0.
- **Carried into the next billing period** is the largest number of unused sessions that pass from one billing period to the next; unused sessions beyond that number expire.
- **Length** and **how far ahead** read 0 on a tier that has no maintenance sessions.

## Reading the card (hypothetical members)

- A Wellness Plus Membership member is credited 2 sessions of 45 minutes each billing period, may book a session up to 30 calendar days ahead, and carries at most 2 unused sessions into the next period.
- A Performance Plus Membership member is credited 4 sessions of 60 minutes each billing period, may book up to 45 calendar days ahead, and carries at most 4 unused sessions forward.
- An Open Gym Access Membership member has no monthly allotment; the single orientation session credited at the start is the only session credit on that tier.
